hook: Put a thought on graph paper.
outcome: Explore real functions, measure rates of change and fit curves to measurements.
sources: Original Curio Class expression parser, adaptive numerical plotter and least-squares routines; MIT licence, copyright 2026 LochLogic (Curio Class), per repository LICENSE. No external library.

NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, Xin Lan and Ralph Keeling (Scripps): co2_annmean_mlo.txt, all 67 annual means 1959-2025, ppm; checked 2026-11-05. Public domain under https://gml.noaa.gov/about/disclaimer.html . Source: https://gml.noaa.gov/webdata/ccgg/trends/co2/co2_annmean_mlo.txt

NASA individual Planetary Fact Sheets: eight rounded J2000 mean semimajor axes in AU and approximate sidereal periods in Earth years; Saturn rounded to 29.45. Checked 2026-11-05. US government data, public domain. https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/planetfact.html ; use terms https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/

US Census Bureau: 1790-1900 from Statistical Abstract 2012 table 1 (unrevised 1870 count), 1910-2020 from Historical Population Change, resident counts rounded to 0.01 million. Checked 2026-11-05; 1940, 1970 and 1980 corrected against source. Public domain, US government work. https://www2.census.gov/library/publications/2011/compendia/statab/131ed/tables/12s0002.pdf ; https://www.census.gov/data/tables/time-series/dec/popchange-data-text.html

OpenStax College Algebra 2e chapter 6: reference for exponential functions and e. Current site licence CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, checked 2026-11-05. No textbook text, figures or datasets bundled; mathematical facts independently computed. https://openstax.org/books/college-algebra-2e/pages/6-1-exponential-functions

Wolfram MathWorld: Rose Curve and Lissajous Curve. Copyright Wolfram Research, reference only, no text or images reproduced. https://mathworld.wolfram.com/RoseCurve.html ; https://mathworld.wolfram.com/LissajousCurve.html

Independent fact checks, references only: NASA Kepler laws (US government work, public domain), OpenStax polar graphs and limits (current CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, no content copied), Emory Math Center limits and Wisconsin Ingersoll Museum Lissajous (copyright their authors, no content copied). https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/orbits-and-keplers-laws/ ; https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/8-4-polar-coordinates-graphs ; https://mathcenter.oxford.emory.edu/site/math111/probSetLimits/ ; https://www.physics.wisc.edu/ingersollmuseum/exhibits/waves/lissajous/
